subject: Implementation playbook canvas — streaming, tool integration, and structured-output alignment
messages:
From: Alex Perez <alex.perez@wellcity.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: WellCity Integration Team <integration@wellcity.com>
Date: 2027-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Implementation kickoff — streaming + tool integration

Hi Irene, Camila,

Thanks for taking time today. We finished our internal scoping and want to align on the practical playbook for: 1) streaming outputs into our contact-center transcripts, 2) tool/function calling hooks to initiate downstream lookups (patient lookup, eligibility check), and 3) structured JSON outputs for downstream ingestion.

High-level asks from WellCity:
- Low latency for short chats (~200–400ms p95 per token) where feasible for agent assist flows
- Deterministic JSON fields for clinical codes so our ETL can map them reliably
- A rollback path to non-streaming synchronous endpoints if we hit quality regressions during early rollout

Can you share a lightweight implementation playbook we can walk through next week? Also attached is a quick inventory of our endpoint constraints (attachment: wellcity_endpoints.csv).

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Perez
Director, Integrations — WellCity Health
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perez <alex.perez@wellcity.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-18T13:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — streaming + tool integration

Alex — thanks for the clear summary.

We put together a one-page implementation canvas (attached: implementation_canvas_v1.pdf) that maps roles, milestones, and the minimal technical contracts we recommend for phase 0. Highlights:
- Phase 0 (pilot): streaming turn-level events + a single function call (patient-lookup) + canonical JSON schema v0 for clinical entities.
- SLOs: target p95 token latency <= 600ms in pilot region; production target will be tightened after benchmarking.
- Fallbacks: automatic downgrade to single-request non-streaming endpoint on >3% error spike for 10 minutes.

Next steps we propose:
1) Joint tech session (60 min) to review schema and tool contract — Camila to lead.
2) CS pass-off checklist and milestone signoff — Monica to own.
3) DocuSign SOW review (we've uploaded a draft).

I attached schema_contract_draft.json with the first-pass required fields and example payloads. Camila, can you add a short note on the expected function signature and error behaviors? Monica, we'll share the CS handoff checklist in the meeting.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: implementation_canvas_v1.pdf, schema_contract_draft.json
From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perez <alex.perez@wellcity.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-19T10:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — streaming + tool integration

Adding technical detail as requested. Below is the concise guidance we'll cover in the joint session.

1) Function / Tool calling contract (patient-lookup) — recommended minimal signature:
- name: "patient_lookup"
- input: { "query": string, "source_system_id": string }
- output: { "patient_id": string, "match_score": number, "metadata": { ... } }
- error behaviors: 5xx -> retry up to 1 time, 4xx -> surface to caller immediately for human fallback

2) Streaming behavior and chunking:
- We'll emit event frames with metadata headers: {event_type, seq, partial} where partial indicates if we expect continuation.
- Clients should apply prefix KV caching for repeated patient context to avoid repeated lookups in the same session.

3) Structured JSON schema notes (from schema_contract_draft.json):
- canonical fields: entity_type, entity_id, confidence, source, start_offset, end_offset
- use snake_case for field names to match WellCity ETL rules
- provide example: {
  "entity_type": "diagnosis",
  "entity_id": "I10",
  "confidence": 0.92,
  "source": "llm:v1",
  "start_offset": 42,
  "end_offset": 51
}

4) Testing & acceptance criteria for phase 0:
- 1000 synthetic sessions with injected edge cases (abbreviations, punctuation)
- Schema validation pass rate >= 99.5%
- Fallback behavior exercised once during simulated outage

I'll present a short runbook with function examples in the kickoff. Irene / Monica — please confirm the duration (60 min) and preferred time slots next week.

-Camila
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Alex — if the 23rd works, we'll send a calendar invite with the Drive folder and DocuSign link.
